info.name: Get the List of Providers for sign.b2e.company.provider.list

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `sign.b2e.company.provider.list` returns a list of signature providers for the selected company. The method works only in the context of application authorization [application](../../settings/app-installation/index.md).
